id: 657-第五與第七次「星際大戰」（蒂卡爾-多斯皮拉斯戰爭）
theater: 佩滕盆地佩特克斯巴通地區

battle.name: 第五與第七次「星際大戰」（蒂卡爾-多斯皮拉斯戰爭）
battle.theater: 佩滕盆地佩特克斯巴通地區
battle.brief: 公元657年，多斯皮拉斯國王巴萊·錢·卡威爾引兵進攻蒂卡爾，迫使蒂卡爾王努恩·烏霍爾·恰克一度棄城，佩滕盆地的均勢就此逆轉；此役正是瑪雅碑銘所稱的「星戰」，以奪取敵國君主為終點的總攻。卡上的羅馬短劍並非戰場實物，它在此標示的是近身刺擊那一環：盾護身、找節奏、一刺致命。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 交戰雙方都是佩滕盆地的瑪雅城邦國家，彼此靠盟誓、進貢與「奪王」而非常備軍交鋒。蒂卡爾（碑銘作 Mutal，髮束徽記）是南部佩滕的首強，國王稱 k'uhul ajaw（神聖之主），權力靠石碑、年終儀式與盟友效忠維持；其軍隊是貴族率領的私人隨從與附屬小寨的民兵，沒有常備編制，也沒有獨立的後勤機構。多斯皮拉斯原本是蒂卡爾在629年設於佩特克斯巴通地區的軍事前哨，用來監視帕西翁河的航線；635年，四歲的巴萊·錢·卡威爾以蒂卡爾王 K'inich Muwaan Jol II 之子身分登位，並沿用蒂卡爾的 Mutul 徽記，宣示自己才是蒂卡爾王位的正統。648年，卡拉克穆爾的蛇王國（Kaan）攻入多斯皮拉斯，俘獲巴萊·錢·卡威爾後把他扶回王位當附庸，這個蒂卡爾的據點自此變成蛇王國插入佩滕南部的刀尖。657年，多斯皮拉斯以聯軍身份反手攻打蒂卡爾，戰線還牽涉北部盆地的卡拉克穆爾、西南的卡拉科爾、帕西翁河上游的伊察，以及多斯皮拉斯的雙首都之一阿瓜特卡。
countriesEn: Both sides were Maya city-state polities of the Petén Basin, and they fought each other through sworn alliances, tribute and the ritual of seizing a rival lord rather than through standing armies. Tikal (written in the inscriptions as Mutal, with the hair-bundle emblem) was the leading power of southern Petén; its ruler held the title k'uhul ajaw, the Divine Lord, and his authority rested on carved stelae, year-ending rituals and the loyalty of client cities. Its fighting force was the private war band of the nobility together with militia mustered from the dependent villages; there was no permanent establishment and no separate logistics organisation. Dos Pilas began as a military outpost of Tikal founded in 629 in the Petexbatún region to watch the Pasión River routes. In 635 the four-year-old B'alaj Chan K'awiil was installed there as a son of the Tikal king K'inich Muwaan Jol II, and he adopted Tikal's Mutul emblem to claim the legitimate succession to the Tikal throne. In 648 the snake kingdom of Calakmul (Kaan) stormed Dos Pilas, took B'alaj Chan K'awiil prisoner and set him back on his own throne as a vassal, so that Tikal's own outpost became the blade that Calakmul pushed into southern Petén. In 657 Dos Pilas turned that blade around and attacked Tikal as the head of a coalition; the same theatre also involved Calakmul in the northern basin, Caracol in the southwest, Itzan on the upper Pasión, and Aguateca, the second capital of Dos Pilas.
people: 關鍵人物集中在兩條王統上。蒂卡爾一方：K'inich Muwaan Jol II（約627至648年在位）把幼子送往佩特克斯巴通，無意中種下分裂的種子；他死後由努恩·烏霍爾·恰克（Nuun Ujol Chaak）執政，正是這位國王在657年被迫放棄都城，又在672年反手攻入多斯皮拉斯，把巴萊·錢·卡威爾逐入五年流亡；692年由「盾美洲豹」西亞赫·錢·卡威爾一世（Siyaj Chan K'awiil I）接棒，他一度在695至696年間與卡拉克穆爾聯手於佩里擊敗卡拉科爾，705年卻再度被多斯皮拉斯將領烏查安·金·巴蘭（Ucha'an K'in B'alam）俘虜。多斯皮拉斯一方：巴萊·錢·卡威爾（625年生）以四歲登位，648年被俘卻沒有被獻祭，反而被扶植為卡拉克穆爾附庸，此後數度入主卡拉克穆爾，682年出席周期結束儀式，686年站在新王登基現場；他的兩個兒子伊察姆納阿·巴蘭與伊察姆納阿·卡威爾先後即位，女兒瓦克·查尼爾（Lady Six Sky，六天空）則被派往納蘭霍重建王朝，成為南佩滕的生力軍。學界方面，格林威治對照值與碑銘釋讀，使657這個西曆年份得以從長紀曆 9.11 年換算定位。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities sit on two royal lines. On the Tikal side, K'inich Muwaan Jol II (ruled roughly 627 to 648) sent a small son to the Petexbatún region and thereby sowed the seed of the split; after his death Nuun Ujol Chaak took the throne, and it was this king who was driven out of his own capital in 657 and who counter-attacked into Dos Pilas in 672, driving B'alaj Chan K'awiil into a five-year exile. In 692 Shield Jaguar II, Siyaj Chan K'awiil I, inherited the throne, joined Calakmul to beat Caracol around El Perú in 695 to 696, and was in turn captured in 705 by the Dos Pilas commander Ucha'an K'in B'alam. On the Dos Pilas side, B'alaj Chan K'awiil (born 625) had taken the throne at four years of age, was taken prisoner in 648 and spared the sacrificial stone, and was instead installed as a vassal of Calakmul; he afterwards visited Calakmul several times, attending a period-ending ceremony there in 682 and the enthronement of the new king in 686. His two sons Itzamnaaj B'alam and Itzamnaaj K'awiil succeeded him in turn, while his daughter Wak Chanil Ajaw (Lady Six Sky) was sent to Naranjo to refound that dynasty and became a force in southern Petén. On the scholarly side, the establishment of the Greenwich correlation and the decipherment of the inscriptions are what allow the year 657 to be pinned down from Long Count year 9.11.
kits: 本卡以一件羅馬短劍（Gladius，約公元前100年定型）作為這場戰爭的代表。短劍是羅馬軍團步兵的標準近身兵器：雙刃、帶護手、劍尖收窄、重心偏前握，用途是刺而不是劈砍，格擋則交給盾與護甲。這件兵器本身從未出現在中美洲，沒有任何考古證據顯示它到達過佩滕盆地；卡面在此代表的是「近身刺擊兵器」這個角色位置。瑪雅戰士的對應裝備是一整套刺擊與投擲系統：投槍器（spearthrower）配黑曜石或石片鑲嵌的標槍，蒂卡爾31號石碑上的青年武士就一手持投槍器、一手持飾有雨水神面容的圓盾；長矛用於列陣與進攻，矛頭以燧石打製；短兵器有鋤形棍棒，以及鑲黑曜石刃的木質長劍（macuahuitl）與石刃棍（tecpatl），但後兩者定型於後古典時期，七世紀中葉的佩滕尚未普遍裝備。防護只有棉或藤織的胸背纏帶、木甲片與矩形盾（texcaxtli），沒有金屬甲。瑪雅軍隊沒有馬匹、沒有車、沒有輪式運輸，也沒有攻城塔與投石機；攻堅靠圍困、火攻、斷水、封鎖堤道與奪取城門，糧秣靠人力背運玉米餅與鹽，部隊則沿帕西翁河與烏蘇馬辛塔河用獨木舟機動。
kitsEn: This card stands for the war with a Roman gladius, a short sword that took its classic form around 100 BC. The gladius was the standard close-combat arm of the Roman legionary infantry: double-edged, with a guard, the point drawn in, and a grip that put the weight forward, its purpose to thrust rather than to chop, with the shield and armour handling the blocking. The weapon itself never appeared in Mesoamerica, and no archaeological evidence shows that it ever reached the Petén Basin; on this card it stands for the role of the close-quarters thrusting blade. The Maya warrior's equivalent kit was a whole system of throwing and thrusting: the atlatl or spear-thrower with obsidian- or flake-set darts, and on Stela 31 at Tikal a young warrior is shown holding a spear-thrower in one hand and a round shield decorated with the face of the rain god in the other. Long spears were formed up for the attack, their heads ground from chert. Short arms included the hoe-shaped club, the macuahuitl or wooden sword with obsidian blades, and the tecpatl, a stone-edged club, although the latter two were consolidated in the Postclassic and were not yet generally worn in mid-seventh-century Petén. Protection amounted to cotton or fibre-woven body bands, wooden slats and the rectangular texcaxtli shield; there was no metal armour. The Maya army had no horses, no carts, no wheeled transport, no siege towers and no stone-throwers. Reduction of a city was done by blockade, fire, cutting the water, sealing the causeways and seizing the gates; supplies were carried by porters as maize cakes and salt; and the columns moved by canoe along the Pasión and Usumacinta rivers.
tactics: 瑪雅戰爭的樣板不追求會戰殲滅，而是以奪取對方君主為終局目標。碑銘把這類總攻稱為 hoyo，即「星戰」（star war），卡名所標的「第五與第七次」即碑銘序列中編為第五與第七的兩場星戰，兩者同屬多斯皮拉斯與蒂卡爾之間的戰爭：657年那一場迫使蒂卡爾王棄城，679年那一場則由多斯皮拉斯的第一號銘板記下戰後的「血池」與「頭顱堆」，是這場戰爭留下的最直接傷亡記載。作戰通常在乾季展開，每年11月至翌年5月是行軍季，6月至10月的雨季令道路泥濘、糧秣難運；行軍多在夜間或拂曉出發，利用雨林與沼澤遮蔽接近，然後在敵方城郊的堤道與樹林地帶設伏或強攻。進攻序列通常是：先以小股游騎切斷對方的邊境小寨與鹽場，再以主隊沿堤道推進，抵達城牆外便圍而不攻，切斷水源與田地，等待城中飢餓、內鬥或貴族倒戈，最後由城內的盟友或被收買者開門，或者直接攻破城門擒住國王與王族。軍隊編制是若干由貴族率領的戰團，獅豹與貓頭鷹兩種精兵名號用來標示那些親自上陣的勇將；俘獲的戰士會被整編進勝方隊伍，被俘的貴族通常被帶回本城獻祭或當眾羞辱。蒂卡爾一城就有十座人工水庫，奪取或破壞水庫往往比攻城本身更能決定城邦的存亡。
tacticsEn: Maya war did not aim at annihilating an army in the field; its aim was to take the opposing ruler as the terminal objective. The inscriptions call such a general campaign a hoyo, a star war, and the fifth and seventh of the card's numbering are the two star wars of that sequence that belong to the fighting between Dos Pilas and Tikal: the one of 657 drove Tikal's king out of his capital, and the one of 679 is recorded on the first Dos Pilas panel, whose text speaks of pools of blood and piles of heads after the fighting, the most direct casualty record this war has left. Campaigns were normally fought in the dry season, from November through May, since the rains from June to October turn the roads to mud and make supply lines fail. Columns moved by night or at first light, using rainforest and marsh to mask the approach, then sprang an ambush or a frontal assault along the causeways and wooded ground outside the enemy city. The usual sequence was this: small mounted-free scouting parties cut the enemy's border villages and salt works, the main body advanced along the causeway, and on reaching the wall the besiegers invested rather than stormed, cutting water and fields and waiting for hunger, factional fighting or a defection among the nobles, until a client or bought gate was opened or the gate itself was forced and the king with his household was taken. The force was organised as a number of war bands led by nobles, with the Jaguar and Owl orders used to mark warriors who fought in person; captured men were incorporated into the victor's ranks, and captured nobles were usually taken home for sacrifice or public humiliation. Tikal alone held ten artificial reservoirs, and seizing or spoiling that water supply often mattered more for the survival of a city than the assault on its walls.
data: 可核對的數字集中在地理與規模上：蒂卡爾位於佩滕盆地，多斯皮拉斯在其西南約110公里，卡拉克穆爾在盆地北緣、距蒂卡爾約100公里，蒂卡爾的老對頭卡拉科爾在東南方約85公里。佩滕西北部地勢是石灰岩脊與沼澤交錯，多斯皮拉斯城址海拔160公尺，位於帕西翁河與薩利納斯河之間，該區年雨量約2,500毫米，蒂卡爾約1,945毫米。多斯皮拉斯王國鼎盛時控制的疆域約1,500平方英里，即3,885平方公里；卡拉克穆爾王國約13,000平方公里，城市人口估計5萬，全國連同鄉村人口約175萬，城址內已識別出6,750座建築，主金字塔高逾45公尺。蒂卡爾核心區面積逾16平方公里，約3,000座建築，核心12公里半徑內人口估計12萬（有學者認為可能偏高），城內另有10座蓄水用的水庫。戰爭年表：629年設多斯皮拉斯，635年登位，648年轉投卡拉克穆爾，657年進攻蒂卡爾，672年遭反攻、677年復位，679年在佩里一帶爆發大戰，695年蒂卡爾一度取勝，705年其君主被俘，731年前後多斯皮拉斯被攻陷，738年卡拉克穆爾勢力退出，761年末代君主出走。整場戰爭自629年分裂起算，延續約90年。
dataEn: The checkable figures are mostly geographic and about scale. Tikal lies in the Petén Basin; Dos Pilas is some 110 kilometres to its south-west; Calakmul sits on the northern rim of the basin about 100 kilometres from Tikal; and Tikal's old enemy Caracol is roughly 85 kilometres to the south-east. The north-western Petén is a lattice of limestone ridges and swamps. The site of Dos Pilas stands at 160 metres above sea level, between the Pasión and the Salinas rivers; the region receives about 2,500 millimetres of rain a year, against about 1,945 millimetres at Tikal. At its height the Dos Pilas kingdom controlled some 1,500 square miles, that is 3,885 square kilometres. The Calakmul kingdom covered about 13,000 square kilometres, with an urban population estimated at 50,000 and roughly 1.75 million including the countryside; 6,750 structures have been identified at the city, and its main pyramid rises more than 45 metres. The core of Tikal covers more than 16 square kilometres with about 3,000 structures, and the population within a 12-kilometre radius of the core is estimated at 120,000, which some scholars regard as too high; the city also holds ten reservoirs. The chronology runs: Dos Pilas founded in 629, the coronation in 635, the switch to Calakmul in 648, the attack on Tikal in 657, the Tikal counter-attack in 672 and the restoration in 677, the great battle around El Perú in 679, a Tikal success in 695, the capture of Tikal's lord in 705, the fall of Dos Pilas around 731, the withdrawal of Calakmul's influence in 738, and the flight of the last ruler in 761. Counting from the split of 629, the war runs for about ninety years.
cause: 這場戰爭不是單一事件引爆的，而是三層原因疊加。第一層是商路：多斯皮拉斯的建立本身就是為了控制佩特克斯巴通與帕西翁河沿線的鹽、黑曜石、染料、玉米與可可運輸；黑曜石來自南部高地，鹽來自薩利納斯河，兩樣都靠這條水道出入，誰控制了佩特克斯巴通，誰就掐住了佩滕南部的進出口。第二層是王權合法性的爭奪：多斯皮拉斯沿用蒂卡爾的髮束徽記，其統治者自認是蒂卡爾王室的直系後裔；卡拉克穆爾則以「蛇王」身分自居區域宗主，一旦多斯皮拉斯倒向卡拉克穆爾，蒂卡爾的南翼與通往佩滕伊察湖的通道就整片暴露，蒂卡爾霸權的基礎隨之鬆動。第三層是城邦時代的結構性壓力：經典期人口增長令貴族階層膨脹，小寨不斷分立，勝者要靠奪取對方君主、重劃附屬城寨來維持金字塔式的權力結構；而瑪雅人沒有常備軍與長途後勤，戰爭多被安排在乾季、以一次總攻解決，這使衝突容易一發即盡，也容易懸而不決。657年的進攻，正是多斯皮拉斯自648年起第一次以攻擊者身分試探蒂卡爾。
causeEn: This war was not triggered by a single incident; three layers of cause stack on top of each other. The first is trade. Dos Pilas was founded precisely to control the salt, obsidian, dye, maize and cacao moving along the Petexbatún and the Pasión: obsidian came from the highlands to the south, salt from the Salinas river, and both travelled by that waterway, so whoever held the Petexbatún held the gateway to the whole southern Petén. The second is the struggle over legitimate succession. Dos Pilas carried Tikal's hair-bundle emblem, and its rulers held themselves to be direct heirs of the Tikal royal line; Calakmul, in turn, claimed to be the regional overlord as the Snake King. Once Dos Pilas turned to Calakmul, Tikal's southern flank and the road to Lake Petén Itzá lay open and the foundations of Tikal's primacy loosened. The third is the structural pressure of the city-state age: population growth in the Classic period swelled the noble order, minor sites split off continuously, and the winner had to take the opposing ruler and redraw the client map to keep the pyramid of power standing. Since the Maya had no standing army and no long-range logistics, wars were scheduled in the dry season and settled in one general campaign, which made clashes easy to start and just as easy to leave unresolved. The attack of 657 was the first time Dos Pilas probed Tikal as the aggressor since 648.
impact: 657年之後，蒂卡爾走進了考古學上所稱的「蒂卡爾中斷期」：國王被迫離城，南方與西南的附屬城寨先後脫離，蒂卡爾在經典期前半段的霸主地位讓位給卡拉克穆爾與多斯皮拉斯，而中斷期的起點也成了考古學者劃分前古典晚期與古典期的重要標尺。戰爭把佩滕盆地的權力重心整體北移，多斯皮拉斯則以掠奪者國家的姿態吞併伊察、阿羅約-德-皮耶德拉、塔馬林迪托，把居民強制遷往佩特克斯巴通，催生了阿瓜特卡與伊察姆察的雙首都體制；它也把佩特克斯巴通王國變成一個從蒂卡爾分裂出來的國家，其歷史最終因被征服而斷裂。長期來看，這條戰線消耗了佩滕兩大城邦的元氣：蒂卡爾要到731年前後才反攻奪回多斯皮拉斯，卻已在南方失去卡拉克穆爾的操作空間；738年基里瓜（Quiriguá）背叛盟友科潘、倒向卡拉克穆爾並贏得獨立，使南佩滕的舊秩序一併崩解。八世紀末，經典期崩潰降臨，中美洲低地再也沒有恢復過同樣的城市規模。對後世研究而言，碑銘中的「星戰」一詞把瑪雅戰爭從「兩軍對撞」重新定義為以擒王為終點、有限卻毀滅性的政治行動；而卡名把「星際大戰」這個流行文化的說法壓在這場戰爭上，恰好與瑪雅人自己的用詞對得上：所謂第五與第七次星際大戰，講的正是多斯皮拉斯兩度向蒂卡爾發動的這類總攻。
impactEn: After 657 Tikal entered what archaeologists call the Tikal hiatus: the king was driven from his city, the client towns to the south and south-west fell away in turn, and Tikal's position as the dominant power of the first half of the Classic period passed to Calakmul and Dos Pilas. The start of the hiatus also became the standard marker by which archaeologists divide the Late Preclassic from the Classic. The war moved the centre of gravity of the Petén north, and Dos Pilas behaved as a predator state, swallowing Itzan, Arroyo de Piedra and Tamarindito and forcibly resettling their people inside the Petexbatún, which produced the twin-capital arrangement of Aguateca and Itzamch'e. It also turned the Petexbatún kingdom into a polity torn out of Tikal, whose history was finally cut short by conquest. In the long run the front line drained the strength of both Petén powers: Tikal did not strike back at Dos Pilas until around 731, by which time it had already lost the room to manoeuvre in the south, and in 738 Quiriguá turned on its ally Copán, switched to Calakmul and won its own independence, collapsing the old southern order as well. By the end of the eighth century the Classic collapse had arrived, and the lowlands of Mesoamerica never regained the same urban scale. For later scholarship, the term star war in the inscriptions pulled Maya war out of the two-armies-clash model and redefined it as a limited yet devastating political act with the taking of a ruler as its endpoint; and the card's title, which lays a pop-culture label over this war, happens to line up with the Maya's own word for it: the fifth and seventh star wars are precisely the two general campaigns Dos Pilas launched against Tikal.
result: 就657年那一役而言，結果是明確的：多斯皮拉斯的聯軍打進蒂卡爾的勢力範圍，國王努恩·烏霍爾·恰克被迫放棄都城，蒂卡爾一時失去對南部附屬的掌控，中斷期自此開始；多斯皮拉斯並沒有佔領蒂卡爾，也沒有自立新王，只留下一次成功的破壞與羞辱。戰爭本身延續了近半個世紀：672年蒂卡爾反攻成功，679年多斯皮拉斯又靠卡拉克穆爾的援軍取勝，705年甚至生擒蒂卡爾之主，一度扶植外來君主坐鎮蒂卡爾王座；直到731年前後蒂卡爾攻入多斯皮拉斯、驅散其居民，738年逐出卡拉克穆爾的影響，佩滕中部的均勢才重歸蒂卡爾。761年，多斯皮拉斯末代國君棄城而去，這個王國從地圖上消失。整體看，這場戰爭以蒂卡爾一方的戰略反攻收場，但勝方付出的代價是南部盟友的崩解；而多斯皮拉斯這個從蒂卡爾分裂出去的前哨，最終被自己的母城回收入編。
resultEn: As for the campaign of 657 itself, the outcome is plain: the Dos Pilas coalition drove into Tikal's sphere of influence, King Nuun Ujol Chaak was forced to abandon his capital, and Tikal temporarily lost control of its southern clients, so the hiatus began. Dos Pilas did not occupy Tikal and did not crown a new king there; what it left behind was one successful raid and one humiliation. The war itself ran for nearly half a century more: Tikal counter-attacked successfully in 672, Dos Pilas won again in 679 with Calakmul's aid, and in 705 it took Tikal's lord alive and for a time seated an outsider on Tikal's throne. Only when Tikal struck into Dos Pilas around 731 and dispersed its population, and pushed Calakmul's influence out in 738, was the balance of central Petén restored to Tikal. In 761 the last ruler of Dos Pilas walked out of his city and the kingdom vanished from the map. On the whole the war was settled by a Tikal counter-offensive, but the victors paid for it with the collapse of their southern allies, and Dos Pilas, the outpost that had split away from Tikal, was ultimately taken back into the fold by its own mother city.
